notes.title: Update Notes - AI and other
notes.content: Improved AI, TD stats, and fixes corrupt season files

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
There was a sneaky bug that caused the game to crash if you had a menu up on the Offensive screen and then clicked the Play Action button.  This has now been fixed.

Added two new settings per users' suggestions:

You can now select "smallest" play images to get a scale more fitting for the field
You can now reduce the music to almost zero during animation
